newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 7.1pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 7.1pct in November.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 7.1 percent in November to 9,623 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said.
The 11 month total of 91,553 tonnes is practically unchanged on 1995, up just 0.7 percent.
Passenger numbers at Lisbon were 2.6 percent higher than the same month last year at 425,776, while the number of aircraft movements rose by 2.4 percent to 6,020.

Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up 35.5 percent in November although the volume was still a relatively modest 3,057 tonnes, taking the accumulated total to 23,997 tonnes, 6.6 percent higher than 1995.
